what: classical selected-CI (CIPSI-type) baseline vs SKQD subspaces, with oracle and random references
owner_request: 2026-10-29: classical selected-CI baseline comparison for all lattices, for the paper

method.importance: Epstein-Nesbet e_a = |<a|H|psi_S>|^2 / (E_S - H_aa) over external states structurally connected to S; E_PT2 = sum_a e_a
method.ranking: |e_a|/max|e_a| rounded to 1e-10 (TIE_DECIMALS), descending, ties by sector-local index
method.batch_information: fixed batch 8 per iteration (gate S1's skqd.controls.cipsi setting), path capped at the largest SKQD size
method.step_rule: target = min(dim, max(|S|+1, ceil(growth |S|))); add the top (target - |S|) of the ranking
method.equal_size_rule: CIPSI(n) = last main iterate S_j with |S_j| <= n plus the top (n - |S_j|) of its ranking (a prefix of the next main step)
method.eigensolver: dense numpy eigh up to 500 states, scipy eigsh(k=2, SA, tol 1e-12) above
method.certificates: skqd.skqd.certify via gate_CV.Sector.basis_metrics at the equal-size points; B=0 Kato-Temple with the exact E1 (width r_H^2/(E1 - E_R)), B=1 Weinstein (width r_H)
method.oracle: skqd.controls.oracle: top-|S| states by exact ground-state weight (no references forced)
method.random_equal_size: gate_CV.Sector.random_at: 200 sets, seeds 23..222 (gate_H0_2x2.RANDOM_SEEDS), references always in
method.random_curve: first 20 of the same seeds, at the CIPSI main-path sizes <= 2500
method.kt_width_random: per random set r_H^2/(E1 - E_R) when E_R < E1, median over the sets where it is defined
method.size_to_reach: smallest n with E_var(n) - E0 <= SKQD's E_R - E0, bisection on the nested family
